maxSegmentBytesArrow.description:
Maximum number of bytes in the segment. By default, this is set to 500MB (500 * 1024 * 1024). If the data being
written exceeds this size, the dataframe is written to multiple files.

format.description: Format to write the data in {@link Feature.Store}.

startIndex.description: The starting index from which filenames will be generated.

requireArrow.description: Throw an error if data cannot be written in arrow format.

disableDynamicSegments.description:
{@Link Feature.Store.write_pandas_to_arrow_store} dynamically segments the pandas dataframe to feather files.
If True, Dynamic segmenting is disabled.

local.description:
If True, use the local filesystem to back persisted data. Otherwise, use the remote filesystem.
See {@link Data.Persisted.Local}.
